snippet.title: Thveit - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Thveit on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924780/Thveit/

Build a thriving settlement where Norse folklore lives beside your people.

Gather resources, shape your village, trade with distant lands, and earn the favor of ancient gods. Every season brings new opportunities, while mythical creatures, wandering spirits, and old legends become part of everyday life.

Join our community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/7kKBjQ7e7B
